rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: Under Article 83(a) of the Constitution, Decree No. 1052 appoints Putin Vladimir Vladimirovich Chairman of the Government; point 2 states that the decree enters into force on the day of its signature; signed 'Президент Российской Федерации Б.Ельцин', Moscow, Kremlin, 16 August 1999, No. 1052.
